authorization: Owner explicitly repeated: do the complete implementation and then push all the changes. This authorizes continuing local development and publishing without repeated permission requests. Historical replay is separated from strict release eligibility; no historical source flag or failed release criterion is waived.
objective: Implement source-bound repository service, exact-budget retrieval, SDK/CLI/stdio MCP, fair deterministic study, supplementary delivery, isolated study/proof tooling and regression coverage.
observable_behavior: Actual source bytes, resolved identities, honest resolver status, strict serialized budgets, stale-handle rejection, real MCP client transport and fail-closed benchmark preflight.
acceptance_tests: Existing interpreter, contracts and benchmark integrity regressions
Actual MCP SDK client initialize/list/call over stdio
Clean wheel install and CLI smoke
negative_controls: Too-small budget and missing exact tokenizer
rollback: Scoped commits only; preserve raw receipts and user-owned staged changes. Default-off supplementary routing. Do not merge.
release_conditions: Independently curated/frozen tasks, qualified controls, real model trials, declared budgets, native telemetry and external acceptance are evidence gates. Implemented tooling is not measured product benefit. Missing resources are NOT_RUN/BLOCKED rather than synthetic success.
